title: Exact Polynomial Storage
objective: Make Node ZZ[x] and QQ[x] PolynomialElement storage canonical sealed generated FLINT resources with packed capability fallback and differential performance gates

handoff.summary: Makes Node ZZ[x] and QQ[x] PolynomialElement values canonically own sealed generated FLINT resources. Construction, coefficient access, equality, arithmetic, powers, evaluation, formatting, and stable bulk SagePack serialization avoid legacy polynomial N-API and uniform per-coefficient limb capacity; the portable tier retains normalized packed storage. Published exact division and factorization results are re-ingested into resources. Direct resource equality and bulk byte-region serialization remove the last measured ordinary-operation materializations, while focused public tests and performance gates cover skewed exact coefficients, persistence, quotient rings, factors, and lifecycle invariants.
risks: Generated exact polynomial resources remain wasm=False; the portable packed implementation is tested, but opaque-resource WebAssembly lowering is still unproved.

Exact division and factorization still use audited packed compatibility materializations internally, including their existing capacity-retry protocol, although no packed value escapes as public Node storage.

SagePack deserialization currently parses the compact stable stream in TypeScript and inserts coefficients through the generated builder; a generated resource deserializer could reduce the remaining roughly 260 ms load time for a 625875-byte QQ polynomial payload.

The shared base contains three integrated task contracts still marked review, so pnpm parallel:check cannot identify exactly one live task in this worktree; all task-specific and architecture validation nevertheless passes.
next_steps: Generate direct resource exact-division and factorization operations, including resource-backed factor collections, then delete the audited packed compatibility paths.
Prove generated opaque-resource lowering on WebAssembly while retaining the same declaration and portable packed semantics.
Add a direct generated resource deserializer if persistence benchmarks show the current builder path matters in applications.
Integrate this branch on top of 4db221db2a73731ef908c7b31149f07ca850fe17 and rerun the combined project validation.
